shortDescription: Manage a bare metal server in the Packet Host

options.name: always_pxe
options.description: Persist PXE as the first boot option. Normally, the PXE process happens only on the first boot. Set this arg to have your device continuously boot to iPXE.

options.name: auth_token
options.description: Packet API token. You can also supply it in environment variable E(PACKET_API_TOKEN).

options.name: count
options.description: The number of devices to create. Count number can be included in hostname using the C(%d) string formatter.

options.name: count_offset
options.description: From which number to start the count.

options.name: device_ids
options.description: List of device IDs on which to operate.

options.name: facility
options.description: Facility slug for device creation. See Packet API for current list - U(https://www.packet.net/developers/api/facilities/).

options.name: features
options.description: Dict with "features" for device creation. See Packet API docs for details.

options.name: hostnames
options.description: A hostname of a device, or a list of hostnames. If given string or one-item list, you can use the C("%d") Python string format to expand numbers from O(count). If only one hostname, it might be expanded to list if O(count)>1.

options.name: ipxe_script_url
options.description: URL of custom iPXE script for provisioning. More about custom iPXE for Packet devices at U(https://help.packet.net/technical/infrastructure/custom-ipxe).

options.name: locked
options.description: Whether to lock a created device.

options.name: operating_system
options.description: OS slug for device creation. See Packet API for current list - U(https://www.packet.net/developers/api/operatingsystems/).

options.name: plan
options.description: Plan slug for device creation. See Packet API for current list - U(https://www.packet.net/developers/api/plans/).

options.name: project_id
options.description: ID of project of the device.

options.name: state
options.description: Desired state of the device. If set to V(present) (the default), the module call returns immediately after the device-creating HTTP request successfully returns. If set to V(active), the module call blocks until all the specified devices are in state active due to the Packet API, or until O(wait_timeout).

options.name: tags
options.description: List of device tags. Currently implemented only for device creation.

options.name: user_data
options.description: Userdata blob made available to the machine.

options.name: wait_for_public_IPv
options.description: Whether to wait for the instance to be assigned a public IPv4/IPv6 address. If set to V(4), it waits until IPv4 is assigned to the instance. If set to V(6), it waits until public IPv6 is assigned to the instance.

options.name: wait_timeout
options.description: How long (seconds) to wait either for automatic IP address assignment, or for the device to reach the V(active) state. If O(wait_for_public_IPv) is set and O(state=active), the module waits for both events consequently, applying the timeout twice.
